definitions.FINANCIAL_DEBT_EQUITY: Reviewed financial borrowings / group equity; no total-liability substitution.
definitions.FINANCIAL_LEVERAGE: Recognized consolidated assets / consolidated equity; excludes client off-balance custody.
definitions.MARGIN_EQUITY: Gross reviewed margin loans / group equity; excludes customer advances and other receivables.
definitions.REPORTED_CASH_FINANCIAL_DEBT: Reported corporate cash equivalents / reviewed financial borrowings; not unrestricted-liquidity coverage.

BQ-EQ.dependency: Reconcile SSI parent/common capital, funds distributions and recurring trading/interest earnings; qualify sustainable returns and capital charge.
BQ-EQ.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

BQ-MOAT.dependency: Qualified SSI customer retention, pricing power, service differentiation and durable cost advantage are absent from the selected financial facts.
BQ-MOAT.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

BQ-CASH.dependency: Reconcile SSI interest cash realization, loan collateral impairments, FVTPL realized/unrealized results and client segregated balances; corporate CFO is not industrial free cash flow.
BQ-CASH.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

BQ-RES.dependency: Qualify margin borrower/collateral concentration, market turnover sensitivity, funding renewal and adverse-cycle response.
BQ-RES.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

FH-BS.dependency: Qualify collateral haircuts, impaired margin exposures, securities concentration, commitments and usable regulatory capital.
FH-BS.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

FH-LIQ.dependency: Map SSI funding maturities, collateral encumbrances, covenants, restricted funds and segregated customer cash; reported corporate cash is not certified unrestricted funds.
FH-LIQ.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

FH-STRESS.dependency: Qualify SSI margin liquidation haircuts, trading shocks and funding rollover constraints before stress assessment.
FH-STRESS.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

GQ-HIST.dependency: Bridge SSI corporate actions, capital raises, restated FY2024 parent profit and dilution; reported group growth is not per-share growth.
GQ-HIST.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

GQ-FWD.dependency: Qualify SSI brokerage/margin demand runway, capital constraints and implementation evidence; historical loan growth cannot establish future growth.
GQ-FWD.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

GQ-INC.dependency: Identify incremental deployed common capital and recurring earnings with compatible lag and economic definitions.
GQ-INC.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

IC-IND.dependency: Qualify dated securities competition, market turnover structure, entry/capital rules and disruption under approved source authority.
IC-IND.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

IC-POS.dependency: Qualified SSI market-share denominators, pricing and customer/channel economics are required; asset size does not prove share.
IC-POS.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

IC-CYCLE.dependency: Qualify SSI cycle behavior across turnover, collateral prices, funding spreads and capital constraints.
IC-CYCLE.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

VAL-PRIMARY.dependency: Owner-approved cutoff, price/share/action source policy, common-owner sustainable earnings and economic assumptions required.
VAL-PRIMARY.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

VAL-RET.dependency: Compatible starting price, action-adjusted shares, distributions, forward scenarios and terminal value approval required.
VAL-RET.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

VAL-MOS.dependency: Approved conservative intrinsic-value assumptions, downside scenarios and compatible price/share cutoff required.
VAL-MOS.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

RG-GOV.dependency: Qualify SSI related-party dealings, minority protections, disclosure changes and actual audit findings; audited status alone does not prove governance quality.
RG-GOV.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

RG-RISK.dependency: Qualify SSI residual market, margin-credit, funding, operational/custody and regulatory risks plus mitigations; avoid duplicate risk deductions.
RG-RISK.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

RG-UNC.dependency: Qualify SSI recurring/trading earnings ranges, revision sensitivity and funding/regulatory uncertainty.
RG-UNC.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

CA-REINV.dependency: Qualify SSI investment/capital-raise decisions and subsequent risk-adjusted economic outcomes; capex is not securities reinvestment.
CA-REINV.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

CA-DIST.dependency: Qualify distributions, retained capital, regulatory resilience and contemporaneous valuation; no assumed buyback benefit.
CA-DIST.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

CA-DIL.dependency: Qualify SSI issue terms, corporate actions, proceeds deployment and adjusted common per-share outcomes.
CA-DIL.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.

CA-PSV.dependency: Reconstruct SSI action-adjusted common-owner per-share value over a cycle using qualified shares and distributions.
CA-PSV.assumptions: No economic assumptions approved; separate analyst qualification and owner authorization required.
